# OCM Solution

> > OCM Solution is an enterprise change management platform combining software, templates, training, and professional services to help organizations manage organizational change effectively.

OCM Solution provides the OCMS Portal—a comprehensive change management software platform—alongside free templates, training resources, and expert services. The platform is built on industry-standard methodologies including Prosci ADKAR and ITIL, serving change managers, project leaders, and enterprise teams.

## Key Topics

- Organizational Change Management (OCM)
- OCMS Portal
- Change Management Software
- Prosci ADKAR Model
- Stakeholder Engagement

- ITIL Compliance
- Free Templates & Toolkits

- Project Management Integration
- Professional Services
